architecture.allowed_inputs: Raw RGB t-2,t-1,t in [0,1] and binary effective causal availability only. No target, task/profile/severity/source IDs, K1 output/residual or generated frames enter the head.
architecture.reuse: Actual existing class is HistoryUtilityGate, not ObservationHistoryGate. Reuse its features() and same1745-parameter net without altering the frozen source.
architecture.features: HistoryUtilityGate.features gives[B*2,11,h,w]: tile16 means of current RGB/history RGB/abs(current-history), lag/2, availability. Absent history is filled from current before feature construction.
architecture.single_output_rule: Apply the same shared net to both slot feature maps; reshape scores[B,2,h,w], then arithmetic mean over slot axis, keeping dimension1. Do NOT multiply this final score by availability: both-absent examples must still judge current-image restoration benefit. Two internal slot scores receive the same single-map objective through their mean; no slotwise benefit labels.
architecture.network: Conv2d11->16,k3,pad1,bias; SiLU; Conv2d16->1,k3,pad1,bias.1745 trainable parameters, FP32, no dropout/normalization. Same first-layer seed and zero final weight/bias in both arms.
architecture.state: No recurrent state, no future inputs, no learned restoration feedback. Existing gate pooling removes within-tile high-frequency arrangement; this first trial does not redesign the feature extractor.
architecture.geometry: H,W positive multiples16, minimum16; crop96 gives6x6. Fail on unsupported geometry; no implicit pad/resize. Tile grid begins at the provided crop origin, not presumed global-frame alignment.

fixed_restorer.model: Exact final1000 MaskAwareRestorer, eval(), all parameters requires_gradFalse and gradNone
fixed_restorer.mode: K1: forward(observed, zeros[B,2,H,W]). Its history filling and condition encoder therefore see current RGB in all three slots.
fixed_restorer.output: Unclamped FP32 k1_rgb; no RGB target enters the forward.
fixed_restorer.invariants: State_dict SHA and parameter versions before/after label export; zero optimizer updates/backwards for restorer. Unit fixture verifies changing raw past with zero weights cannot change K1.

composition.hard_rule: correction_mask=(benefit_score>0). Exact0,positive/negative zero ties preserve input. Nonfinite score/output fails; no epsilon/threshold search.
composition.spatial_rule: Nearest-neighbor repeat_interleave16 in both spatial axes; no interpolation, feathering, overlap or post-filter in this first isolated trial.
composition.raw_output: torch.where(pixel_mask,k1_rgb,current_rgb); avoids floating arithmetic in bypass branch and guarantees bitwise raw preservation when maskFalse.
composition.evaluation: Score unclamped output plus separately clipped[0,1] deployment output and clipping statistics. Never train through hard threshold/RGB composition in this trial.
composition.risk: Hard16pixel boundaries may introduce seams and per-frame decision flicker. Record actual composed-image PSNR/MAE/LPIPS, boundary residual-gradient jump relative to raw/K1, and stride1 action-map flip rate. No flow-aware temporal-quality claim from those statistics. No adaptive smoothing selected on dev.

fixed_train_rows.split: train19 only; revised cohort and source/group train/dev exclusion unchanged
fixed_train_rows.reuse_rule: Use all16000 existing numeric student rows in original order,1000 contiguous batches16, including12native+2identity+2near_clean per batch. Preserve crop/frame/control noise and true_availability*external_mask. teacher_mask must beNone. No row resampling or dev labels.
fixed_train_rows.all_rows_valid: Single restoration-benefit map is supervised even when both histories are absent. Do not apply the old per-history valid-slot loss mask.

labels.numerics: Actual FP32 RGB; independent CPU FP64 absolute-error/channel/spatial mean for raw benefit. Retain both tile MAEs and raw FP64 benefit.
labels.training_target: FP32 clip(raw_benefit/(0.25/255),-4,4), explicitly borrowed from the original utility normalization.
labels.loss: Mean SmoothL1(beta=1) over all B*1*6*6 entries between single benefit_score and detached normalized target. No RGB fidelity loss, class reweighting, confidence weighting, target-dependent sampling or extra auxiliary loss.
labels.interpretation: A bounded normalized signed-benefit predictor, not calibrated expected MAE gain/probability. Saturation is recorded and signs/ties remain raw-ground-truth diagnostics.

new_train_cache_required.why: Existing headroom RGB caches are dev6 only. Teacher training forward outputs used changing weights/masks and were not final-teacher K1 predictions. Neither can become train19 labels.
new_train_cache_required.export_budget: Exactly1000 batched frozen-K1 forwards of16 rows=16000crop predictions;0restorer backward/optimizer update. No repeated label export per arm.
cache_per_batch: all row hashes, full observed/current/target float32 SHA, teacher SHA, source/source-group/window/crop/control/source-pixel bindings
new_train_cache_required.features_backend: CPU Torch FP32,2CPU threads, exact frozen features() math on the loader CPU observations before copying observations to the NPU restorer. Save actual FP32 features. Use this same CPU feature/head backend for training and the first cached-dev comparison; require exact cached-feature versus recomputed-feature parity. No cross-CPU/NPU parity is assumed and no automatic head-backend switch is permitted.
new_train_cache_required.audit: Independent CPU reuses verified train19 source NPZ/rows to reconstruct current/target and features, reads saved K1 arrays, and recomputes signed labels. It does not replay K1. Freeze actual file/array/row/implementation SHAs; exclude source fields from network features.
new_train_cache_required.resource_proposal: One bounded new label-export run,4CPU/32GiB hostRSS/12GiB immutable-source cache,<=900s, single fresh admitted NPU card with existing health/lock/idle policy. This is a proposed cap, not measured completion time; failure stops, no automatic retry/extension.

dev_cache_reuse.target_scope: Dev targets only scoring, oracle diagnostic and integrity; never training labels.
dev_cache_reuse.history_not_directly_saved: Six-array NPZ has only current raw crop, not an explicit fullK3 tensor.
dev_cache_reuse.exact_reconstruction: Index every cached current by(source,profile,frame,crop). Each source/profile has all96frames with the identical center crop. Reconstruct[x[max(t-2,0)],x[max(t-1,0)],x[t]] from cached current arrays; near-clean uses the already saved corresponding raw current. Verify C-contiguous FP32 stack against each original records.jsonl observed_crop_sha256_float32, and current/target/K1/row/file hashes.
dev_cache_reuse.failure_policy: Any missing row/history/SHA mismatch stops cached-dev evaluation. Do not silently switch to source NPZ or generate new histories/model outputs.
dev_cache_reuse.conditional_saved_compute: Only after exact reconstruction passes: evaluate both heads on reconstructed observations and compose with already cached K1;0new restorer forwards. This exact reuse has not yet been executed.
dev_cache_reuse.required_new_two_candidate_diagnostic: During this single dev-cache preparation pass compute tilewise min(input,K1), exact ties prefer input, separately for degraded/identity/near_clean/source/phase. Existing four- and five-candidate oracle results are not the input+K1 two-candidate bound. No extra model call and no additional repeated scan now.
dev_cache_reuse.scope_limit: Only96x96center crops. Full-frame480x832 gate/K1 behavior needs later separately bounded inference; crop caches do not supply full-frame restoration outputs or exact full-frame condition features.

shuffled_control.same_except: Both identical1745parameter initialization, rows/features, optimizer,1000steps, one loss coefficient1, inference composition and final checkpoint step. Only normalized whole-map label assignment differs.
shuffled_control.old_map_not_usable: Old donor_map is per valid history slot with history-lag strata; this experiment has one benefit map per row and includes both-absent rows.
shuffled_control.unit: One entire1x6x6 benefit map for each of16000rows; no pixel/tile permutation.
shuffled_control.source_exclusion: Donor source_id and source_group_id must both differ from recipient. Metadata only; never choose donors by errors/labels/results.
shuffled_control.algorithm: Seed20261112; adapt existing SHA256-keyed group ordering and within-group row ordering; cyclic rotate by largest source-group row count within each stratum. Require largest group<=half stratum and exact donor bijection/no reuse.
shuffled_control.failure: If any stratum infeasible, record it and block both head-training arms pending design review. No hidden coarsening, new RNG/resampling or borrowing dev rows.
shuffled_control.normalization: Permute saved normalized complete maps. Preserve the overall and stratum label distributions exactly; no per-arm extra labeling cost.

head_training.checkpoint: Complete head/optimizer/RNG/row cursor/row+donor+cache hashes; final1000only for comparison, no dev checkpoint selection. Smoke checkpoints excluded.
head_training.resource_proposal: Separate2CPU/4GiB/900s bounded CPU run per arm after actual short CPU backend smoke. No completion-time claim or automatic NPU fallback.
head_training.backend: CPU Torch,2threads, TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0; exact runtime versions pinned at implementation. NPU is needed only for the separately admitted fixed-K1 label export, not for this small head.

minimum_tests_before_admission: Final-layer zero initialization gives exact raw output; zero/signed-zero ties preserve input; NaN fails.
Changing unavailable past or target/metadata cannot alter head features/prediction; only raw observed+availability accepted.
K1 zero-weight invariance and full frozen state/parameter-version checks.
Single-map signed label formula, all-absent supervision, clipping/sign and hard16pixel boundary fixture.
Train-only role/source/group binding, strict donor bijection/strata and infeasible fail-closed fixture.
Exact dev K3 reconstruction against stored full-observation SHA; missing neighbor and altered current/near-clean bytes reject without fallback.
Identical matched/shuffle initial tensors, strict checkpoint reload/RNG/step, optimizer touches only1745 head parameters.
Actual composed output metrics (including a seam fixture) differ from choosing optimistic tile oracle; no target enters compose.
acceptance_scope: Compare fixed final matched head against shuffled head, raw and K1 on actual composed outputs at threshold0. Report source-balanced native fidelity, control harm, worst-source/phase and correction/flip/seam coverage. Bypass-all is not restoration progress. No automatic acceptance from oracle gain or label-regression accuracy; root must freeze the exact comparative acceptance rule before training. This new experiment does not reopen the failed original teacher gate or claim independent test quality.
next_order: Implement isolated head/composition and CPU tests; freeze new donor metadata and exact execution contracts.
One bounded train-only final-K1 label export and independent cache audit; prepare dev rawK3 reconstruction+two-candidate diagnostic using existing arrays.
Short head-backend smoke, then separately admitted matched/shuffled1000step head runs; no restorer training.
One paired cached-dev evaluation with actual composed outputs; if justified, design independent source-disjoint test/full-frame temporal evaluation separately.
